data.name: MEMOLOGY: ESCAPE OF MEMES
data.detailed_description:
Immerse yourself in a world of crazy fun and memes runner with Memology: Escape of Memes! This game combines the dynamic gameplay of an endless runner and a vibrant, intense world filled with your favorite characters from Internet culture. Run as surfer, destroy obstacles and collect upgrades to become a meme master!

Game Features:

  • Vibrant Characters: Play as iconic memes and characters from MEMOLOGY: GOYDA and MEMOLOGY: WAR OF MEMES. Each character has unique abilities and style!

  • Dynamic gameplay: Avoid obstacles by collecting power-ups and upgrades. The further you run, the more memes you can collect!

  • Upgrades and Abilities: Upgrade your heroes! Unlock new abilities that will help you overcome difficulties and outrun your rivals.

  • Unique graphics and music: Immerse yourself in an atmosphere of nostalgia with vivid graphics and catchy music that will make you smile.

Don't miss the chance to become a part of meme culture and upgrade your skills in Memology: Escape of Memes! Start your adventure in the world of memes now!

data.short_description: This time you have to escape with memes on runner like surfer. Where to? The hint is the very advertisement that everyone loves so much on the famous video hosting! The great continuation of the Memology game series with understanding concept by anyone without needs to play previous game. Let's run!
